prompt.text: Name a piece of lab equipment
prompt.label: Lab equipment
prompt.subject: lab

answers.name: Soxhlet extractor
answers.blurb: Invented by Franz von Soxhlet in 1879 to extract fat from solid samples. It sounds wonderfully obscure, but most organic chemistry students have watched one siphon away for hours.

answers.name: Inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectroscopy
spellings: inductively coupled plasma atomic emission spectroscopy

answers.name: Liebig condenser
answers.blurb: Named after Justus von Liebig, who popularised it in the 1800s but didn't invent it: Christian Weigel described the same water-cooled design in the 1770s. It's on nearly every school distillation diagram, so it's far less obscure than it sounds.

answers.name: Swan neck flask
answers.blurb: Louis Pasteur boiled broth in flasks with S-shaped necks: air got in, but dust and microbes stuck in the bend, so the broth stayed sterile. It helped kill off the idea of spontaneous generation.
